notes: The body is mostly sound: Ch 3's taxonomies, CSR, special stakeholders, employee rights, accommodation and cross-cultural material trace. Many body claims draw on source passages the deep ref lacks (multiple roles, MITRE detail, Equifax, 'steward of the public interest', Benioff 1-1-1, UDHR, environmental dumping, latent-public window): cycle them to the deep. The integrity tail is the problem: the worked-example provenance note (line 158) and the evidence-marker paragraph (line 210) cite non-existent chapters (1.4, 13.1), a wrong chapter for tone at the top (5.4 for 11.3), wrong markers ([AP] for [V]/[BT]), and cases absent from the source (Bhopal, Nestlé); the borrowed-through list mis-chapters Kant, Mill/Bentham, Rawls and Hardin and adds Freeman, who is not cited in the body. Training-data leakage: power-interest quadrant prescriptions (KC5) and a Wells Fargo scandal (Phase 4).
